pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Linux kernel sources with NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10 Grace-Blackwell) enablement.
7.0.0 is NVIDIA's linux-nvidia-7.0 source package taken whole: the upstream orig tarball plus the Ubuntu .diff.gz that carries the packaging and the full GB10 patch set. Upstream renumbered the release, so the tree reports version 7.0.14 rather than a 6.x number. No patches from files/ are applied.
6.17.0 is the older approach -- vanilla 6.17 plus fifteen patches ported by hand from NVIDIA's 6.17 diff -- and is masked as broken. The arm-smmu-v3 iGPU domain-type quirk those patches carry is required for the integrated Blackwell GPU: without it GSP firmware initialisation fails and the GPU cannot be used. That quirk is merged in the 7.0 tree.
